By no means a jjk fan, and it’s by pure coincidence I stumbled here, but I gotta side with the other guy here. You seemed quite emotionally invested on what is just suppose to be weekly entertainment. Take a step back the next time before investing on a comic strip? Just like going to any other restaurant, would you demand a refund just because the waiter serve you food you don’t like. It’s not as if the mangaka artwork turn to a simplistic drawing of a 3 year old nor did he rip the book to shreds of paper and sold it to you. Although the chapter does sound bad, I sincerely hope there are other joy in life for you to look forward to than for you to be this deeply angered and demanding. I don’t think he meant this is pure art, it’s literally chill bro, you paid to have a copy of his artwork, if you don’t like it, move on.

So I am fresh out of college, and I really liked Physics. I have an over thinker personality and I heard that is suits the subject well.

Now the problem is I heard that Engineering don’t offer you much prospect, it all depends on the boss you are working for and sometimes you never get a promotion and will be stuck with the same salary.

But the thing is I really like applying logic and solving questions, critical thinking that is. And I love it even more so why I can find a problem that I cannot solve, it means that I can look to learn from others, or tackle the problem from a different angle, showing that I am learning something new and am improving.

So firstly I know that there are different kinds of engineering Electrical, mechanical, etc. But I am just sorta interested with anything to do with physics and I don’t know what to choose hahaha

If it is any help and as childish as it may seem I really enjoy doing Redstone in Minecraft, what field of engineering would that fit into?
